config.source:
WITH cat_list AS (
  SELECT
    plan_id,
    CONCAT_WS(', ', COLLECT_SET(issue_category)) AS categories
  FROM workspace.pbm_sim.findings_registry
  GROUP BY plan_id
)
SELECT
  r.plan_id,
  p.funding_model,
  p.state_domicile,
  r.affected_members,
  r.total_findings,
  ROUND(r.total_dollar_exposure, 2) AS total_dollar_exposure,
  c.categories
FROM workspace.pbm_sim.findings_plan_rollup r
JOIN workspace.pbm_sim.plan_design p
  ON r.plan_id = p.plan_id
LEFT JOIN cat_list c
  ON r.plan_id = c.plan_id
ORDER BY r.total_dollar_exposure DESC

config.source:
WITH numbered AS (
  SELECT
    DATEDIFF(run_date, (SELECT MIN(run_date) FROM workspace.pbm_sim.daily_recon_log)) AS day_num,
    total_exposure
  FROM workspace.pbm_sim.daily_recon_log
),
rolling AS (
  SELECT
    day_num,
    ROUND(AVG(total_exposure) OVER (
      ORDER BY day_num ROWS BETWEEN 13 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ), 2) AS roll_14d
  FROM numbered
),
last30 AS (
  SELECT * FROM rolling
  WHERE day_num >= (SELECT MAX(day_num) - 29 FROM rolling)
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    (COUNT(*) * SUM(day_num * roll_14d) - SUM(day_num) * SUM(roll_14d))
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*) * SUM(day_num * day_num) - SUM(day_num) * SUM(day_num), 0),
  2) AS slope_per_day,
  CASE
    WHEN slope_per_day < -10 THEN 'CONVERGING'
    WHEN slope_per_day > 10 THEN 'DIVERGING'
    ELSE 'STABLE'
  END AS verdict
FROM last30

config.source:
SELECT
  p.plan_id,
  p.funding_model,
  p.state_domicile,
  CASE
    WHEN r.plan_id IS NULL THEN 'NO FINDINGS'
    WHEN r.total_dollar_exposure > 200000 THEN 'ACTION REQUIRED'
    WHEN r.total_dollar_exposure > 100000 THEN 'MONITOR'
    WHEN r.total_dollar_exposure > 0 THEN 'REVIEW'
    ELSE 'CLEAR'
  END AS status
FROM workspace.pbm_sim.plan_design p
LEFT JOIN workspace.pbm_sim.findings_plan_rollup r
  ON p.plan_id = r.plan_id
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN r.total_dollar_exposure > 200000 THEN 1
    WHEN r.total_dollar_exposure > 100000 THEN 2
    WHEN r.total_dollar_exposure > 0 THEN 3
    ELSE 4
  END,
  p.plan_id

config.source:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('week', run_date) AS week_start,
  ROUND(AVG(total_exposure), 2) AS avg_exposure,
  ROUND(
    AVG(total_exposure) - LAG(AVG(total_exposure)) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('week', run_date)),
  2) AS delta,
  CASE
    WHEN delta < 0 THEN 'IMPROVING'
    WHEN delta > 0 THEN 'WORSENING'
    ELSE 'FLAT'
  END AS direction
FROM workspace.pbm_sim.daily_recon_log
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('week', run_date)
ORDER BY week_start DESC
LIMIT 8

config.source:
WITH status_calc AS (
  SELECT
    p.plan_id,
    CASE
      WHEN r.plan_id IS NULL THEN 'NO FINDINGS'
      WHEN r.total_dollar_exposure > 200000 THEN 'ACTION REQUIRED'
      WHEN r.total_dollar_exposure > 100000 THEN 'MONITOR'
      WHEN r.total_dollar_exposure > 0 THEN 'REVIEW'
      ELSE 'CLEAR'
    END AS status
  FROM workspace.pbm_sim.plan_design p
  LEFT JOIN workspace.pbm_sim.findings_plan_rollup r
    ON p.plan_id = r.plan_id
)
SELECT
  status,
  COUNT(*) AS plan_count
FROM status_calc
GROUP BY status

config.source:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    issue_category,
    COUNT(*) AS findings,
    SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative,
    SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS total
  FROM workspace.pbm_sim.findings_registry
  GROUP BY issue_category
)
SELECT
  issue_category,
  findings,
  ROUND(cumulative * 100.0 / total, 1) AS cumulative_pct,
  ROUND(findings * 100.0 / total, 1) AS pct_of_total,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY findings DESC) AS sort_order,
  CASE WHEN cumulative * 100.0 / total <= 80 THEN 'Key Drivers' ELSE 'Minor Issues' END AS pareto_group
FROM ranked
ORDER BY findings DESC
